page.title: System Configuration
page.subtitle: Edit the on-disk application.yml from this UI. Changes are persisted but require an application restart to take effect. Secrets (passwords, tokens) are masked — type a new value to replace them.

comments.label: Comments
comments.hint: Fields marked with the info icon have a comment — hover the icon to read it.

status.enable: Enable (uncomment on save). Enabling a section also enables its contents.
status.disable: Disable (comment out on save). Disabling a section also disables its contents.

restart.title: Restart required
restart.message: Configuration saved. Restart the server for changes to take effect.
